description: This file defines the CloseConnection command class, which is used to close a specific connection in the Discord platform. It includes methods for constructing instances, serializing to/from JSON, and identifying the connection to be closed.

classes.name: CloseConnection
classes.description: Represents a command to close a specific connection identified by ConnectionId. Extends AbstractCommand and implements ConnectivityModifyCommand to interface within the command handling framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance with specified ConnectionId and headers, checking that neither is null.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a CloseConnection command from a JSON string or JSON object, given headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command's payload to JSON, including the connection ID.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ConnectionId associated with this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the resource path, here '/command'.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated headers.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if this object can be equal to another, used in equals.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for semantic equality of CloseConnection instances.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on ConnectionId and superclass properties.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: String representation of the command, including connectionId.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new CloseConnection instance with connection ID and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static factory method to parse the command from JSON (string or object).

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Add the connection ID to the JSON payload during serialization.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Retrieve the connection ID associated with the command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Get the JSON pointer to the command resource path.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Create a new command instance with updated headers.
